full_page.content:
C. 1948
The following are faithful transcriptions of photocopies of handwritten messages to his brother James' family by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
(On small holy pictures)
1. To niece, Aurelia Herkenrath:
To know God and to appreciate is to advance - to one science necessary, - Sanctity. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
2. To nephew-in-law, Leon Herkenrath Sr:
0 St. Joseph Model and Patron of worthy Fathers. Teach us Perseverence for Jesus. Fr. Solanus, O.F .M.Cap.
3. To grand-nephew Leon Jr.
Like to Holy Trinity, Faith, Hope and Charity are one. Theoretically Faith - like the Eternal Father comes First But in both cases they are essentially one. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Originals in possession of: Mrs. Aurelia Herkenrath 1019 108th Ave., N/E. Apt. 117 Bellevue, Wash., 98004
( Aurelia Casey Herkenrath, daughter of James Casey)
